study_design: Prospective cohort analysis within the Prostate, Lung, Colorectal, and Ovarian cancer screening trial
cohort_total_n_excerpt: In the Prostate, Lung, Colorectal, and Ovarian cancer screening trial, of the 97,334 eligible individuals, 10,399 developed cancer.
reason: The study includes incident prostate cancer among its site-specific cancer outcomes, but the abstract reports no aggressive prostate cancer endpoint.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: Cancers included were 145 head and neck, 99 oesophageal, 136 stomach, 1137 lung, 1703 breast, 257 endometrial, 162 ovarian, 3037 prostate, 318 kidney, 398 bladder, 103 gliomas, and 106 thyroid.
